correctness.rationale: Self-contained exact verifier reconstructs GP(8,3), separately enumerates all 6813 faces by degree and by components, and produces an ordinary acyclic matching with one critical vertex and three critical 6-cells. All 35104 Hasse incidences sorted exhaustively. Forman CW gives three six-spheres integrally, without unproved attaching maps. Eight exact oriented-simplex Lefschetz traces yield the C8 character (3,-1,-1,-1,3,-1,-1,-1); rational decomposition epsilon plus V4 and zero invariant dimension follow. Additional GF(2) boundary ranks corroborate, not replace, proof. Self-audit was applied to the exact final graph, matching, group action and parameter.

originality.rationale: Targeted searches of indexed mathematical results with seven distinct formulations found close studies of ordinary independence of this exact graph, its matching and cut complexes, and two-independence of the different Petersen graph. Three closest complete public results were read and show no statement implying the new integral two-independence wedge or its cyclic H6 character. The complete primary Deshpande-Singh higher-independence preprint was inspected; its explicit family hypotheses exclude this graph. A second broader chordal result is inapplicable. An equivalent unindexed proof remains a residual risk, not a claim of certified global novelty.
residual_risks: Equivalent but unindexed dissociation-complex calculations of GP(8,3) may exist.

value.rationale: Möbius–Kantor GP(8,3) is a classical uniquely small cubic symmetric incidence graph and the next natural higher-independence parameter after its studied ordinary independence complex. Its nonpure 7-dimensional simplicial complex unexpectedly collapses homotopically to three S6 spheres; its order-eight rotation has no rational invariant sixth-homology class. Both are mathematically motivated structural invariants not deducible from known ordinary independence or basic face counts, and provide a tractable nonchordal benchmark.
